newsitem.title: ALBANIA: SOCCER-ALBANIAN COACH QUITS FOLLOWING WORLD CUP DEFEAT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ALBANIAN COACH QUITS FOLLOWING WORLD CUP DEFEAT.

text.p: Neptun Bajko resigned as coach of the Albanian soccer team on Tuesday in the wake of last week's 3-0 home defeat by Portugal in a World Cup qualifier.
Bajko, who had coached the team since August 1994, said he quit because his players had refused to follow his tactics in the group nine match in Tirana on Wednesday.
The Albanian Football Association said it had not yet appointed a replacement for Bajko. It denied local media reports it was looking for a foreign coach.
